title: Passionate Percolation
html:
Quest Giver: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Delve into The Frigid Bean to collect frequent buyer cards and to steal some of the special beans.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Tastes Like Mud

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Delve into The Frigid Bean to collect frequent buyer cards and to steal some of the special beans.

Offer:

This has got to stop, or better yet it needs to continue. I have a plan but it will take a brave Dungeon Runner, not a simple pusher of Joe like me. You need to go into Balzack's Burrow night club and find the entrance to The Frigid Bean. Once there go find a Karlbucks Coffee stand and steal a bag of beans for me. While you're there gather a handful of Karlbuck Frequent Buyer Cards, if you can, so I can cash them in for more free coffee to sell as my own. HaHaHa!

Once you have these things bring them back to me, seriously, no taking them back to Townston. That would just not do, I need you to bring them right here to me, don't go out for a bagel or a glass of iced tea. If those beans are exposed to any more air than need be they might just go bad, or sprout or become refried. Can you even imagine how terrible re-fried coffee beans would be? I don't even think Zliten would eat them.

Don't forget about me, Javier, for all your coffee needs. I am here in Balzack's Base Camp just waiting for you to come back!

Turn-in:

The only thing that smells better than some cowboy coffee is the gold all these monsters will pay for my 'New and Improved' coffee!

This is going to work wonders! Not only am I able to cut costs by you bringing me this bag of beans, thank you again for this gift by the way, but I don't even have to have it inspected by the TDA since it never went to Townston.

Objectives:

  • Bag of Frigid Beans ×1
  • Karlbuck Frequent Buyer Cards ×15

Level range: 55–100
